name: Cadence, Inc.
old_description: Cadence is the leading manufacturer of custom sharps solutions, enabling better outcomes for OEMs, surgeons, and patients. Our sharps solutions provide unique geometries for superior cutting or piercing.
about:
Cadence, Inc. is headquartered in DeLand, Florida. The company operates as a contract manufacturer specializing in medical devices and precision components for the MedTech and pharmaceutical industries.

Cadence provides vertically integrated contract manufacturing from complex components to finished devices. Its core capabilities include custom sharps (specialty blades and needles), plastics overmolding, insert molding, and injection molding; complex machining such as Swiss, screw, micro, PEEK, and LaserSwiss; precision metal stamping with microstamping, multi-slide, and reel-to-reel technology; deep draw forming; metal injection molding (MIM); and precision laser processing (welding, cutting, marking, drilling, ablation). The company runs certified ISO Class 7 and Class 8 cleanrooms at dedicated facilities in Cranberry Township, Pennsylvania, and Alajuela, Costa Rica, and operates FDA-registered, cGMP-compliant sites in Pennsylvania, Virginia, Costa Rica, Rhode Island, and Wisconsin. It also designs and builds custom automation equipment for assembly and inspection.

Cadence serves MedTech and Pharma original equipment manufacturers worldwide, supporting applications in medical devices, drug delivery systems, and diagnostics. Customers range from large multinational OEMs to early-stage innovators requiring design for manufacturability (DFM), design for assembly (DFA), prototyping, process validation (IQ/OQ/PQ), and new product introduction (NPI) support.

The company emphasizes a single-source model that consolidates the supply chain, reduces time to market, and leverages external expertise. A dedicated sterilization management facility and comprehensive quality system (ISO 13485:2016, FDA 21 CFR Part 820) are cited as key differentiators for ensuring compliance and patient safety.
